description: The Greenhouses Modelica library couples greenhouse climate and crops with thermal generation, storage and control systems. It includes heating, ventilation, CHP and heat-pump components relevant to district-energy integration. The provider is queraltab (repository owner). Coverage: The library is generic to configured greenhouse and energy systems. No geographic dataset or common observation period is supplied by the README. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The provider states BSD 3-Clause and free source availability. A compatible Modelica environment is separately required. Limitations: The documented purpose includes energy infrastructure, not only crop growth. External reuse and current maintenance were not established. For simulation it can represent greenhouse heat demand and its coupling to energy infrastructure. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers this named Modelica library.
